Pitch Meetings are back, now 50% more blond!

Marvel has been trying real hard to get another big win since the so-so reception of all their Phase 5 offerings.

Well in summer 2025 they bet big on Marvel’s First Family, the Fantastic Four - and you know what? It was okay. It was alright. It was a moderate success.

The Fantastic Four: First Steps definitely raises some questions. Like what’s up with Johnny’s eyeballs? Why is so much of this movie just news reels? Why are big purple guys so angry all the time?

To answer all these questions and more, step inside Ryan George’s Pitch Meeting for The Fantastic Four: First Steps. It’s super easy, barely an inconvenience.
